query_normalized: predicting the impact of composition on the band gap of perovskite materials materials science
rationale: This paper directly addresses the user's question by developing machine learning models to predict band gap energies based on atomic and structural descriptors (composition) for halide perovskites, satisfying criteria (a) for measuring the same mechanism and (b) for addressing the independent variable (composition) and dependent variable (band gap) within the specific domain.
